Version 1.0.1 of opsrobot

- No file changes detected from the previous version.
- No visible updates or modifications to documentation or functionality.

Initial release of opsrobot – Openclaw观测平台

- Provides installation and configuration guidance for the Openclaw observability platform based on Apache Doris.
- Supports log analysis and monitoring, including both日志 and otel metrics data collection.
- Offers step-by-step Docker-based deployment instructions.
- Assists with Vector and diagnostics-otel client setup for collecting and forwarding logs/metrics.
- Enables users to monitor digital workforce operations via a user-friendly web interface.
